# Bonus depreciation, Section 179, or plain MACRS? Compare all three.

> Free calculator comparing 100% bonus depreciation, a Section 179 election, and plain MACRS depreciation for a new equipment or asset purchase — with the 2025/2026 OBBBA dollar limits and phase-out, the net-operating-loss vs. carryforward distinction, and cash tax savings for each path.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
